final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT account_id AS c1, COUNT(*) AS c2 FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), s2 AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT SUM(c2) FROM s1) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL) AS c1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c2 - s2.c1 AS c3 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.c1), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s3) SELECT s3.c1, s3.c2, s3.c3, s3.c2 - s4.c1 AS c4 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.c1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c4 DESC LIMIT 10
